quality_ceiling.perfect_era_b_arm: 12/12 declared checkpoints - every checkpoint has at least one accepted shape, so a perfect arm scores the full 12
quality_ceiling.partially_correct_arm: scores strictly less: 12/12 wrong-value mutants rejected and 9/9 negative controls not passing, so a wrong value still costs its checkpoint

grid_quality_precondition.why: all 64 correct rows pass and all 9 negative controls fail - era B's answer shapes no longer manufacture a zero on the 1,016-request grid
